title: Qualify the exact registration trace clock origins in its limitations text
outcome: The exact registration trace names the separate phase and StateInner observer clock origins so consumers do not compare their microsecond offsets directly.
acceptance: The in-band exact-trace limitations text accurately distinguishes phase-ring monotonic offsets from the process-wide StateInner observer offsets; it does not claim a shared origin.
A source review confirms the wording matches the actual clock owners and leaves registration decisions unchanged.
